## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [玄奘](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%8E%84%E5%A5%98) Xuánzàng records the Buddha's *parinirvāṇa* discourse on the *fǎ zhù* 法住 (the abiding of the Dharma in the world after his death). The work is one of Xuánzàng's smaller post-India translations.

**Abstract**

The translation belongs to Xuánzàng's Cháng'ān period (645–664 CE).
